::: {.home-position}
**Professor of Mathematics**  
[University of Bergen](https://www.uib.no/en)
:::

My research is in algebraic topology and related areas of mathematics. Current interests include homotopy theory, combinatorial models for homotopy, and methods inspired by topological data analysis.

On these pages you can find information about my [research](research.qmd), [publications](publications.qmd), [teaching](teaching.qmd), and [curriculum vitae](cv.qmd).
